document.abstract: Next-generation TV is a big phrase and is most often used in conjunction with ATSC 3.0. Those who have recently viewed a screen are well aware that Internet Protocol (IP) streaming makes up the majority of our viewing habits, and the versatility, flexibility, and interactivity that IP delivers have changed the media landscape forever.
